objective: Separate PermissionGate loading presentation from resolved permission denial across the web UI.
requirement_gap: PermissionGate currently renders its denial fallback while session role is still loading, causing screens with denial copy to transiently claim permission failure before authorization is known. DOC-D loading/disabled/error law requires distinct truth states.
success_invariants: loading never reuses denial fallback implicitly
resolved null/disallowed role still renders denial fallback
callers may provide explicit loadingFallback when desired
